title: Accredited Program business card · Specifications for front
slide_intent: Fit the person, program and channels onto one small surface. A recipient should be able to identify the local program as well as the individual representing it.
strategic_value: The same business-card structure can identify an accredited program through both the lockup and its red contact-block name.
demonstration: A maximum-content example shows the program-name lockup and color-coded alignment guides. Two James Olsen cards compare standard and enlarged contact type.
practical_value: Fix the name and title positions, then build the program address upward from the lower margin. Use the larger-text option when the address is short enough.

content_islands.name: Card specification
content_islands.spec: Set dimensions, inks, stock and placement settings in the left column, including the bilingual reverse option.

content_islands.name: Contact construction
content_islands.spec: Show the program identifier in the mark and in red above the address. Use separate guides for fixed title lines and the stack of contact lines.

content_islands.name: Type-size alternatives
content_islands.spec: Place standard and larger contact settings side by side using the same program and cardholder.
